prompt: Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Libre Baskerville; geometric heading with a contrasting reading serif. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
